feed.subtitle: When an agenda is posted or changed, and when a meeting’s recording, transcript and our minutes are all in.

entry.title: Stormwater Task Force: the meeting of 14 September 2026 — recording, transcript and our minutes
entry.summary: Task force approved its stormwater warrant article for special town meeting by unanimous roll call. The recording is on the town’s channel (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fHuUxPFr0rg), its captions are searchable, and our minutes are written from them; the video at its timestamp is the record.

entry.title: Stormwater Task Force: the meeting of 31 August 2026 — recording, transcript and our minutes
entry.summary: Task force will draft a non-binding article asking town meeting to choose stormwater utility vs. operating budget funding. The recording is on the town’s channel (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=N5dSxGy3zZs), its captions are searchable, and our minutes are written from them; the video at its timestamp is the record.
